project.name: oxiguitar-musescore
project.description: A placeholder scaffold for a MuseScore format plugin for OxiGuitar. MuseScore support was dropped on 9 November 2026; this repository is kept only as an empty scaffold with CI, licensing, and contribution rules shared across all OxiGuitar plugin repositories.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview: explains that oxiguitar-musescore is a placeholder scaffold for a MuseScore format plugin for OxiGuitar. States that MuseScore support was dropped on 9 November 2026; users should export from MuseScore as MusicXML instead. Includes credits and licence information.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Changelog following Keep a Changelog format and Semantic Versioning. Documents the addition of the Understand Anything knowledge graph analysis for this repository.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contribution guidelines for the repository. Describes branch model (develop/main), pull request workflow, and Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) sign-off process. Links to the main OxiGuitar contributing guide for code standards.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Standing rules for working on this repository with Claude. Covers library policy, telemetry rules, no-emoji policy, DCO sign-off, branch management, Rust version constraints, and PR workflow. References the OxiGuitar START-HERE.md as the source of truth.

nodes.name: pull_request_template.md
nodes.summary: Pull request template requiring 'What changed' and 'How to try it' sections, plus a checklist covering tests, docs, CHANGELOG, CREDITS, corpus files, and DCO sign-off.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow with jobs for Rust detection, formatting, linting (clippy + docs), testing across 6 platforms, license/advisory checking (cargo-deny), and DCO sign-off verification. The ci-success job aggregates all results.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: Dependabot configuration for weekly version updates on cargo dependencies and GitHub Actions, with a limit of 5 open PRs per ecosystem.

nodes.name: deny.toml
nodes.summary: cargo-deny configuration defining allowed licenses (GPL-3.0, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, etc.), advisory policy, ban rules for multiple dependency versions and wildcards, and source restrictions (crates.io and OxiGuitar SDK git only).

nodes.name: clippy.toml
nodes.summary: Clippy linter configuration setting MSRV to Rust 1.99 and allowing unwrap/expect/panic/indexing in test code.

nodes.name: rustfmt.toml
nodes.summary: Rust formatter configuration setting edition 2024 with 100-character line width and field init shorthand.

nodes.name: check-dco.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that verifies DCO sign-off on every commit in a git range. Skips automated bot commits (Claude GitHub app, Dependabot) and checks that human commits carry a matching Signed-off-by trailer.

nodes.name: .gitignore
nodes.summary: Git ignore file for the repository, excluding build artifacts, dependency directories, and generated files.

nodes.name: LICENSE
nodes.summary: GNU General Public License v3.0 or later. The project and its contributions are licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

nodes.name: knowledge-graph.json
nodes.summary: Understand Anything knowledge graph capturing the project's architecture with nodes, edges, layers, and a guided tour for codebase navigation.
